column1: # Session misses 26/08/2026 — module 03 rungs 0–1. Rewritten to CARD-RULES.md (incl. the stand-alone-question rule).
In Python, what does "2" + 2 do? {{c1::TypeError}} — + adds or glues, it never {{c2::mixes number and text}}.
In Python, what does a function return if no return statement ever runs? {{c1::None}} — print-instead-of-return is the classic cause.
In Python, what is the difference between return and print? return {{c1::hands a value back — usable, testable}}; print {{c2::paints pixels and returns None}}.
In Python, how do you check a string contains at least one digit? {{c1::any(ch.isdigit() for ch in pw)}} — pw.isdigit() asks {{c2::"is the WHOLE string digits?", the wrong question}}.
In Python, what does any(...) take and give back? Takes {{c1::a stream of booleans}}, gives {{c2::one: True if at least one is True}}.
Which branch of a Python if/elif chain runs? {{c1::The FIRST true one, top to bottom}} — the rest skipped even if also true.
In Python, what does 2 + 2.5 evaluate to? {{c1::4.5, a float}} — numbers mix freely; only {{c2::number-meets-TEXT}} errors.
Your fix is right but the checker still fails — what is the first thing to check? {{c1::Is the file SAVED? (VS Code: ● on the tab)}} — the checker runs what's on disk.
